experiment: v8 existing final EMA snapshot ensembles
candidates: all valid character spans with scaled GP logit > -32 in any original inference window; no gold-based proposal
deduplication: maximum GP window and attached boundary confidence retained together for each model
fusion_missing: GP=-32, boundary logprob=-16 and boundary probability=exp(-16), with separate presence indicators
features: per model: GP/8, boundary logprob, exp(boundary); log1p span length; per-model presence; same/other train entity counts
baseline: audited v6 fits and predictions reused without modification
selection: fit-only Micro, then Macro13, then prefer baseline, then fewer models; same fixed text-hash halves
acceptance: full-dev Micro >= v6, combined crossfit Micro > v6 and neither held-out half decreases; otherwise retain v6
normalization: fit-only means, std, type eligibility and ridge-logistic coefficients
decoder: unchanged original/expanded Micro threshold search from v4; no extra threshold sweeps
scope: exploratory dev only, checkpoint snapshots already saved by completed training; no parameter updates or test access
